market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela ~988k bpd in March 2026; reaching 1.4m requires ~42% increase in 9 months. Sanctions and infrastructure constraints make rapid expansion very difficult. Historical recoveries have been slow. Very low probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of major sanctions relief / production breakthrough.
